resource_limits.derivation: Policy-derived ceilings, not empirical benchmark results: max process-group RSS is a conservative 60% of captured total_memory_kib (7671308 * 0.60, rounded down to 4602784 KiB); max swap delta is fixed at 256 MiB (262144 KiB). Stop loss is 80% of the RSS ceiling (3682227 KiB, rounded down) and 50% of the swap ceiling (131072 KiB).
resource_limits.source: Captured host resources in this compiler-baseline.json plus the resource-safety policy in test-strategy.md section 1; no local performance benchmark was used to select these limits.

turbo_concurrency_source: TURBO_CONCURRENCY=1 env var per test-strategy.md section 1; turbo.json does not pin global concurrency
graph_db_freshness_rule: stat -c %Y graph.db compared to date +%s; age < 86400 (24h) means fresh; no rescan performed
